module "S8_LayerBlendFrontMaterial.dss"

product 0 MaterialLayerBlend "B_S8_LayerBlendFrontMaterial" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(BlendInputRelevance="Bottom", InputName="Bottom", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=0) : material @L6:C1 "Bottom"
  %1 = FunctionInput(BlendInputRelevance="Top", InputName="Top", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=1) : material @L6:C1 "Top"
  %2 = FunctionInput(InputName="Alpha", InputType="Scalar", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=2) : float @L6:C1 "Alpha"
  %3 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%0) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L8:C28 "FrontMaterial"
  %4 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%1) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L8:C50 "FrontMaterial"
  %5 = Reflected[HorizontalMixing](Background=%3#6, Foreground=%4#6, Mix=%2) : Substrate @L8:C23 "FrontMaterial"
  %6 = MakeMaterialAttributes(FrontMaterial=%5, Opacity=%4#4) : material @L6:C1
  %7 = FunctionOutput(%6, OutputName="R", SortPriority=0) @L6:C1 "R"
  inputs %0, %1, %2
  outputs %7
